audience: online sellers that manage marketplace orders, stock and shipments in PowerHub

useCases.title: Check the new orders from each marketplace
useCases.text: List orders with their status, buyer and marketplace source. Filter by order date or external id, and open one order for its delivery details.

useCases.title: Check the stock of a product per warehouse
useCases.text: Find the products by SKU or EAN. Read the stock in hand, reserved and ordered per warehouse, with the storage place.

useCases.title: Track a parcel by its waybill number
useCases.text: Filter shipments by waybill number. Open one shipment to read its carrier, receiver and status history.

useCases.title: Review invoices and the amounts paid
useCases.text: List the sales documents, invoices and receipts, with buyer, amount, currency and paid amount.

useCases.title: Look up a product's price, EAN and size
useCases.text: Find a product by name, EAN or SKU. Open it to read its base price, price lists, dimensions and weight.
